intent: A rotary knob for a bounded numeric value (audio inspector): a 270° arc that fills to the value, with a typed value field (NumericInput) below.
use_when: A bounded numeric parameter where a knob is the idiom (frequency, depth, reverb).
You want drag + keyboard + typed entry on one control.
dont_use_when: A plain number field — use NumericInput.
An unbounded value — a dial implies a min/max.

tokens.note: DS CSS variables only (light + dark); no hardcoded hex — verified.

a11y.typed: the NumericInput value row mirrors the knob for typed edits, and is a horizontal drag-scrub surface.
